verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party AI Toolkit explicitly connects AI coding agents to Shopify's developer docs and API schemas, and the agent docs are served as markdown pages (for example docs/agents.md). That satisfies the "agent-oriented docs" branch of the story, even though the probe found no llms.txt at shopify.dev. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index (the probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs, and explicit documentation of the markdown doc endpoints as an agent-facing feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The toolkit connects your agent to: Developer docs and API schemas
Shopify AI Toolkit connects your AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs, API schemas, and CLI store management so they can help you build more accurately.
Shopify AI Toolkit gives your AI coding tool a Shopify-aware starting point.
